hunt.name: Autonomous Swarm Endpoint Operations
hunt.description: This hunt targets the endpoint-side tradecraft of autonomous multi-agent systems. While these swarms coordinate over public web infrastructure, they exhibit unique behavioral markers on the host: specifically, automated reasoning patterns that result in sub-second process execution bursts and a reliance on predictable file-naming conventions to track state across distributed agents. We first identify known swarm IOCs by hash, filename, and command-line arguments, then parallelize the hunt to find high-speed execution patterns and discovery-oriented probing files.

config.scoping_notes: Start with servers and development environments where container escapes are most likely. The high-speed burst query may trigger on compilation or CI/CD tasks; use scope_hosts to exclude known build servers if necessary.
config.beyond_detection: A standard detection rule might catch the specific filenames, but this hunt uses a behavioral baseline of sub-second process bursts to find agents even when they rotate their filenames and hashes.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, process_hash_sha256, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{swarm_hashes}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_hash_sha256) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{swarm_filenames}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(process_cmd_line), 'content.js') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(process_cmd_line), 'f4b1f888f29faa7fbec180f42bdc78596e8a8b908c0a6e6c419933703c81df85.js') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify any hosts executing known swarm binaries or scripts by hash, image name, or as arguments in a command line.
config.expected_signal: Direct hits on known agent filenames or hashes. This confirms presence of specific swarm versions.

primitive_config.label: Known swarm IOC execution
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, process_hash_sha256, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{swarm_hashes}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_hash_sha256) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{swarm_filenames}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(process_cmd_line), 'content.js') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(process_cmd_line), 'f4b1f888f29faa7fbec180f42bdc78596e8a8b908c0a6e6c419933703c81df85.js') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Direct hits on known agent filenames or hashes. This confirms presence of specific swarm versions.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_name, file_path, activity_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE LOWER(file_name) LIKE 'artex-probe-%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find files created with the artex-probe prefix used by swarms to coordinate local state.
config.expected_signal: File creation events for predictably named state files. This is a high-fidelity indicator of this specific agentic framework.

primitive_config.label: Predictable discovery probing
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_name, file_path, activity_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE LOWER(file_name) LIKE 'artex-probe-%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: File creation events for predictably named state files. This is a high-fidelity indicator of this specific agentic framework.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, substr(time, 1, 19) AS second_bucket, COUNT(*) AS burst_count FROM hb_process_activity WHERE activity_id = 1 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, second_bucket HAVING burst_count > 5 ORDER BY burst_count DESC
config.description: Detect the sub-second reasoning intervals where multiple processes are launched in the same second, typical of automated agents.
config.expected_signal: Groups of process launches occurring within the same second on a single host. High burst counts indicate automated script or agent activity.

primitive_config.label: High-speed process bursts
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, substr(time, 1, 19) AS second_bucket, COUNT(*) AS burst_count FROM hb_process_activity WHERE activity_id = 1 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, second_bucket HAVING burst_count > 5 ORDER BY burst_count DESC
primitive_config.expected: Groups of process launches occurring within the same second on a single host. High burst counts indicate automated script or agent activity.

config.success_criteria: A verdict of malicious | suspicious | benign for each host, citing specific process and file rows.
